about: « Initiative », per agent, at the very bottom of its page (passation-pro briefs/design-agents-proactifs.md §2 and §7.1; Alex 22/11: D1 A, D3 A, D4 B; texts validated 22/11 08:53). The bridge keeps it (bridge-rs/src/agent_proactive.rs) and tells it in the agent's settings; the apps draw it (AgentPageView.swift, AgentPageScreen.kt). Read by bridge/tests_blackbox/test_agent_proactive.py (the bridge's answers), HermesKit AgentInitiativeTests and Android AgentInitiativeTest (what the apps read and draw). Additions only: an app 1.0 ignores `proactive` and draws nothing.

routes.settings: GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/settings: + `proactive: {level, smart_ok}`; absent for an agent other people talk to (the family's agent, a project agent, an agent shared with a relative or linked with another household's agents: vault.rs `others_facing`).
routes.put: PUT /v1/agents/{agent_id}/proactive {level} → {id, level}. 404: not an agent of this place. 409 {"detail": "others_facing"}: an agent other people talk to. 422: a level not in `levels`.
routes.off_by_words: « arrête de me proposer des choses »: the agent's tool `proactive_off` sets « off », only in a turn of its person's own conversation (never a routine's, a watcher's, a trigger's, a task's, a relative's or another household's turn), and never turns it back on. Every app version sees it in the settings.
routes.file: <data>/agent_proactive.json (0600): {"levels": {"<agent id>": "off" | "basic" | "smart"}}. An agent absent from it is « basic »; « basic » is never written (the file holds only what the person changed).

settings.name: own_agent_default
settings.about: One of the person's own agents nobody changed: basic, everywhere (D4 B), old agents too (D1 A).

settings.name: own_agent_smart
settings.about: The person chose « Intelligente ». `smart_ok`: its model passed the smart offers' bench (§3b.8); none has yet, so false.

settings.name: own_agent_off
settings.about: Turned off (on its page, or by its person's words).

settings.name: project_agent
settings.about: An agent other people talk to: no `proactive` at all, whatever is stored.

rules.apostrophes: The texts are written with the apps' typographic apostrophe (’); the design note's straight ones are the same words.
rules.where: At the very bottom of the agent's page, after « Notifications » and the tools' line (« N outils », « Validations », « Peut écrire à »): a small heading, three segments, one grey line under them. Nothing else on the page moves.
rules.hidden: No `proactive` in the settings (an app 1.1 on a bridge 1.0, an agent other people talk to), or a level the app doesn't know (a newer bridge): nothing drawn, not even the heading.
rules.line: The grey line says what the chosen level does (`texts.<lang>.line_<level>`).
rules.untested: With « Intelligente » chosen and `smart_ok` false, a second grey line under it: `texts.<lang>.untested`. Never under « Éteinte » or « Basique ».
rules.tap: A tap on a segment shows it at once and sends PUT {level}; the answer's `level` is kept. A failure puts the previous level back: a 409 says `texts.<lang>.others_facing`, anything else the app's usual error line.
rules.demo: The demo keeps the level on the phone (basic for every agent).

cases.name: smart_ok_missing
cases.about: `smart_ok` missing: taken as true (nothing to warn about).

cases.name: unknown_level
cases.about: A newer bridge's level: nothing drawn.

fr.title: Initiative
fr.line_off: Il ne propose rien de lui-même. Il fait ce que tu lui demandes.
fr.line_basic: Des rappels et quelques offres simples au bon moment : trajet, rappel, agenda, recherche. Rien ne se fait sans ton oui.
fr.line_smart: Il te propose tout ce qu’il sait vraiment faire, et repense à ta journée plusieurs fois par jour pour te proposer une idée. Rien ne se fait sans ton oui.
fr.untested: Son modèle n’est pas encore testé pour ça : ses offres peuvent être moins justes.
fr.others_facing: Cet agent parle à d’autres personnes : il ne propose rien de lui-même.

en.title: Initiative
en.line_off: It doesn’t suggest anything on its own. It does what you ask.
en.line_basic: Reminders and a few simple offers at the right time: route, reminder, calendar, search. Nothing happens without your yes.
en.line_smart: It suggests anything it can really do, and looks back over your day a few times a day to suggest ideas. Nothing happens without your yes.
en.untested: Its model isn’t tested for this yet: its offers may be less accurate.
en.others_facing: This agent talks to other people: it never suggests anything on its own.

de.title: Initiative
de.line_off: Es schlägt nichts von sich aus vor. Es tut, worum du es bittest.
de.line_basic: Erinnerungen und ein paar einfache Angebote zur richtigen Zeit: Weg, Erinnerung, Kalender, Suche. Nichts passiert ohne dein Ja.
de.line_smart: Es schlägt dir alles vor, was es wirklich kann, und geht mehrmals täglich deinen Tag durch, um dir Ideen vorzuschlagen. Nichts passiert ohne dein Ja.
de.untested: Sein Modell ist dafür noch nicht getestet: Seine Angebote können ungenauer sein.
de.others_facing: Dieser Agent spricht mit anderen Menschen: Er schlägt nie von sich aus etwas vor.

es.title: Iniciativa
es.line_off: No propone nada por su cuenta. Hace lo que le pides.
es.line_basic: Recordatorios y algunas ofertas sencillas en el momento justo: trayecto, recordatorio, agenda, búsqueda. Nada se hace sin tu sí.
es.line_smart: Te propone todo lo que de verdad sabe hacer, y repasa tu jornada varias veces al día para proponerte ideas. Nada se hace sin tu sí.
es.untested: Su modelo aún no está probado para esto: sus ofertas pueden ser menos acertadas.
es.others_facing: Este agente habla con otras personas: nunca propone nada por su cuenta.

urgent.about: What is urgent (§2.4, Alex Q3 A): an urgent payment (already, notify_payment_urgent), a watcher's URGENT message, later a plan's urgent moment. Never an offer. No quiet hours of ours: the phone's Do Not Disturb and Focus decide.
urgent.push: A Boîte message pushed urgent (contracts/notifications/types/boite.json, variant `urgent`): `aps.interruption-level` « time-sensitive » and `urgent: 1` in the payload (FCM data: "1"). Everything else as a usual Boîte message.
urgent.ios: Time Sensitive from the 1.0 on: the level is in the notification and the right is in the app's entitlements already.
urgent.android: 1.1: its own channel `urgent` (`texts.<lang>.channel_urgent`, importance high), for any push with `urgent: "1"` that is not an urgent payment (those keep `payments_urgent`). 1.0: the « Messages » channel, as any Boîte message.
